Added the release run-up (April–November 2003) and April 2004 criticism. Sources (Players Committee forum, each cited with a Preserved copy on the article):
* [http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=34606#34606 Anyone know when V-Card set #6 will come out...] (post 34606, generaljarjarbinks, 21 October 2003; [https://web.archive.org/web/20040306021847/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=36771%26amp Internet Archive])
* [http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=34625#34625 Anyone know when V-Card set #6 will come out...] (post 34625, Yoda Killa, 21 October 2003; [https://web.archive.org/web/20040306021847/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=36771%26amp Internet Archive])
* [http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=36006#36006 Virtual cloud city pre-release] (post 36006, moremachinethanman, 11 November 2003; [https://web.archive.org/web/20040112230749/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=36520%26amp Internet Archive])
* [http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=44980#44980 SWCCG worlds and more] (post 44980, deadbody, 18 April 2004; [https://web.archive.org/web/20040709185410/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=45251%26amp Internet Archive])
* [http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=44998#44998 SWCCG worlds and more] (post 44998, Darth Hoth, 18 April 2004; [https://web.archive.org/web/20040709185410/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=45251%26amp Internet Archive])
=== Missing data ===
* Post 36717 ("out friday possibly", tournament legal a week later): a rumour, superseded by the dated release. Left out.
* Post 37611: a player's PDF problem ("The viewer cannot decrypt this document", fixed by a newer Acrobat) on 26 November 2003. The post says "the new virtual cards" and does not name the set. Left out.
=== Possibly faulty data ===
* The pre-release topic (11–16 November 2003) discusses a Yoda (V) with Yoda's Gimer Stick, and Nick Kolnik mentions a Yoda (V) eaten by Bubo at a Wisconsin State Championship. No Yoda (V) is in the set's card list in the article. Not added; worth checking whether a Yoda (V) was in the pre-release and later dropped.

* [http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=36663#36663 Spoiler Discussion IV: The Search For More Money], Jedi K (17 November 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040105033003/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=2390%26amp Internet Archive]
* [http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=36676#36676 Spoiler Discussion IV: The Search For More Money], Matthew Ting (17 November 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040105033003/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=2390%26amp Internet Archive]
* [http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=39033#39033 Spoiler Discussion IV: The Search For More Money], Greg Anderson (GregAndersonPC) (30 December 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040115061724/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=38706%26amp Internet Archive]
* [http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=39035#39035 Spoiler Discussion IV: The Search For More Money], KingFelix (30 December 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040115061724/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=38706%26amp Internet Archive]
* Left out: "The posted texts were not reworked much before release" (Jedi K): post 36663 says players had been told problems would be ironed out in playtesting, not that the texts were not reworked. Left out.
* Possibly faulty data: The 17 November 2003 spoiler list (post 36668) names Brief Loss Of Control and Impressive, Most Impressive among the set's cards; on the wiki both are in [[Virtual Set 7: Shadows Of The Empire]] ([[Brief Loss Of Control (V) (Virtual Set 7)]], [[Impressive, Most Impressive (V) (Virtual Set 7)]]), and the released Virtual Set 6 has [[Atmospheric Assault (V) (Virtual Set 6)|Atmospheric Assault (V)]], which the spoiler list does not name. That the two cards were moved from Virtual Set 6 to Virtual Set 7 is likely but not stated in these sources, so it is not in the article.

== 15 July 2005 forum typing, 25 November 2026 ==
A 15 July 2005 typing of the full set texts by CRingwell, in the Players Committee forum topic "Virtual Set 6" (t=6357), was added to [[Virtual Set 6: City In The Clouds]] from the Internet Archive capture of 18 June 2006. The card texts themselves were not copied onto the set page; the capture is cited as a source. This is the pre-2009 set, not the post-2014 [[Virtual Set 6]].
